results.description: a first-order RC low-pass filter with a 1kHz cutoff frequency and a 5V DC source. Harness requirements: name the input node 'in' and the output node 'out'; give the input source an AC magnitude of 1 so AC analysis works.

attempts.netlist:
RC Low-Pass Filter, fc=1kHz
* Vin: DC 5V with AC magnitude 1 for AC analysis
Vin in 0 DC 5 AC 1
R1 in out 1k
C1 out 0 159.15n

.control
op
print v(in) v(out)

ac dec 20 1 1meg
print ac v(out)

tran 10u 5m
print tran v(in) v(out)
.endc

.end

results.description: a common-emitter BJT amplifier using an NPN transistor (2N2222-style model) with a small-signal voltage gain of approximately -50, powered from a 12V supply, with proper bias resistors and coupling capacitors; include an AC analysis demonstrating the mid-band gain. Harness requirements: name the input node 'in' and the output node 'out'; give the input source an AC magnitude of 1.

attempts.netlist:
* Common-Emitter BJT Amplifier (2N2222-style), Gain ~ -50, Vcc=12V

.model QN2222 NPN(IS=14.34f BF=200 VAF=100 IKF=0.3 RB=10 CJE=25p CJC=8p TF=0.4n TR=60n)

* Power supply
Vcc vcc 0 DC 12

* Input source with series resistance and AC stimulus
Vin in 0 DC 0 AC 1
Rs in b_in 600

* Coupling capacitor into base
Cin b_in base 1u

* Bias resistors (voltage divider)
R1 vcc base 220k
R2 base 0 16k

* Collector resistor
Rc vcc coll 5k

* Emitter resistor with bypass capacitor
Re emit 0 100
Ce emit 0 100u

* Output coupling capacitor and load
Cout coll out 1u
RL out 0 10k

* BJT transistor
Q1 coll base emit 0 QN2222

.control
op
print v(base) v(coll) v(emit)

ac dec 20 1 1meg
print vdb(out)
print vm(out)
let gain = vm(out)/vm(in)
print gain

* Print gain at approximate mid-band frequency (1kHz)
let midband_index = 20
print gain[midband_index]
.endc

.end

results.description: a non-inverting op-amp amplifier with a gain of 11, using an ideal op-amp model (e.g. a voltage-controlled voltage source with high gain), with a 100mV 1kHz sine input; show the amplified output in transient analysis. attempts.netlist:
Non-inverting op-amp amplifier with gain of 11

.endc

.end

results.description: a full-wave bridge rectifier with four diodes and a smoothing capacitor sized so the output ripple is less than 1V peak-to-peak into a 100 ohm load, driven by a 12V RMS 60Hz sine source; show the steady-state output ripple in transient analysis. Harness requirements: name the output node 'out' (across the load).

attempts.netlist:
Full-wave bridge rectifier with smoothing capacitor, 12V RMS 60Hz source, 100 ohm load

Vin A B SIN(0 16.97 60)

D1 A out DMOD
D2 B out DMOD
D3 0 A DMOD
D4 0 B DMOD

Rload out 0 100
Cout out 0 2000u IC=0

.model DMOD D(IS=1e-14 N=1.5 RS=0.5)

.control
tran 50u 200m 0 uic
meas tran vout_max MAX v(out) FROM=150m TO=200m
meas tran vout_min MIN v(out) FROM=150m TO=200m
meas tran vout_ripple PARAM='vout_max - vout_min'
print vout_max
print vout_min
print vout_ripple
print v(out)
.endc

.end

results.description: a basic buck converter stepping 12V down to 5V (within 3%) with a 100kHz switching frequency and output ripple under 100 mV peak-to-peak, using a voltage-controlled switch driven by a pulse source with the appropriate duty cycle, a freewheeling diode, an LC output filter, and a resistive load; show the output voltage settling in transient analysis. Harness requirements: name the output node 'out'.

attempts.netlist:
Buck converter 12V to 5V, 100kHz switching, LC output filter

Vin 1 0 DC 12
Vctrl gate 0 PULSE(0 5 0 10n 10n 4.167u 10u)

* Voltage-controlled switch from Vin to switching node
S1 1 sw gate 0 SWMOD
.model SWMOD SW(Ron=0.01 Roff=1Meg Vt=2.5 Vh=0.5)

* Freewheeling diode: anode at ground, cathode at switching node
D1 0 sw DMOD
.model DMOD D(Is=1e-14 Rs=0.01 N=1.0 Cjo=1e-11 Tt=1e-9)

* LC output filter
L1 sw out 100u IC=0
C1 out 0 47u IC=0

* Resistive load
Rload out 0 5

.control
tran 100n 2m 0 uic
print v(out)
.endc

.end

spec_check.target: V(out) = 5 V ±3% average, ripple ≤ 100 mVpp, steady state
